name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (gfx/render domain). 'render_party_roster_grid' accurately describes the body: it renders the 2-column x 3-row party-roster grid (portrait + class/job name + selection border) into a target surface. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Render the party-roster grid (2-column x 3-row, up to 6 visible characters): per character it blits a 24x24 portrait (with blink-frame variant) and the class/job name, plus a selection border glyph on the highlighted entry.
logic_summary: blink_frame = subframe_counter, remapped to 1 when counter==3 (cycle 0,1,2,3 -> 0,1,2,1). draw_count = menu_party_member_count, capped to 6 when count>6, further clamped to 5 when count < scroll_offset+6 (scroll-tail). For iter in 0..draw_count-1: char_idx = scroll_offset + iter; col_off = (iter%2)*0x84 (2 columns); row_off = (iter/2)*0x1A (3 rows, signed divide). Blit 24x24 portrait via fd2_tile_blit_24x24_with_dialog_bg_fill from portrait cache offset cache[char_idx*0x30 + blink_frame*4] to (row_off+0x75)*0x140 + surface_offset + 0x0E + col_off. border_glyph = 0xC9 when (scroll_offset+iter)==highlight_idx else 0xCD. Draw class/job name via fd2_display_dialog_scene(all_game_text, rt_chars[char_idx].char_id + 1, (row_off+0x79)*0x140 + surface_offset + 0x28 + col_off, 0x140, border_glyph, 0x4C, 0,0,0). __CHK(0x44) is a compiler-injected stack-probe prologue.

params.name: highlight_idx
params.semantics: The roster index that should receive the 'selected' border glyph (0xC9); all other visible entries get 0xCD. Compared against scroll_offset+iter each iteration. Callers pass data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (or 0 for the initial render before any cursor movement).
params.reason: Name accurately reflects use: it is the index highlighted with the selection border. No address residue.

params.name: surface_offset
params.semantics: Base address/offset of the destination drawing surface. Used as the common base for both the portrait-blit destination and the dialog-scene name destination. Callers pass 0xA0000 (direct VGA framebuffer) or a 64KB off-screen composite buffer pointer (render_workspace_c) when sliding the panel in.
params.reason: Name accurately reflects use: it is the destination surface base offset added to every blit destination. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; renders directly into the surface designated by surface_offset.
